method: Whole-file manual reading of 752-line demo folder translation JSON plus duplicate-preserving JSON parse and structural filename checks of every value. No claim of fluent semantic translation validation for every language.
findings: 25 language dictionaries each contain the same28 keys:700 values total. Duplicate JSON keys rejected by parser; none found.

Every value is nonempty and passes checked Windows forbidden characters/control characters, trailing dot/space, dot entry and common reserved device basename checks. No normalized NFC/casefold duplicate values within any complete language dictionary. This is a conservative synthetic structural check, not execution on Windows filesystem.

The capture script maps en-us to en and zh-cn to zh; its27 target codes therefore resolve to these25 dictionaries. Fixed current names avoid the collision concern recorded for arbitrary future translations, without making the script validate those cases.

Russian demo names separate Photos/Фотографии from Pictures/Изображения and preserve distinct Reports/Отчёты and Annual Reports/Годовые отчёты. These names are display fixtures, not duplicate-engine correctness evidence.
limits: No localized filesystem trees, screenshots, Windows executable or complete UI translations tested. No foreign production code adopted.
